title: Encoder Input
text: Read from one or multiple incremental encoder input channels, 2 outputs, {Reset input function} sets Select mode of; {Install new board} sets the register a board < no board, {Delete current board} sets the delete the current board, {Board setup} sets the up the board, {Sample time}, {Maximum missed ticks} sets the number of timer ticks by which your model can trail, {Show “Missed Ticks” port} sets the send number of missed ticks to port Missed, {Yield CPU when waiting} sets the yield CPU while kernel waits for hardware, {Input channels} selects encoder input channels, {Quadrature mode} sets the to detect optically the amplitude and direction of movement, select encoder stripe edges, {Input filter clock frequency} sets the cutoff frequency and {Output data type} sets the data type of block. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: Encoder Data
ports.summary: Encoder data read from input channels vector

params.name: Install new board
params.values: Register a board < no board selected > (default)

params.name: Maximum missed ticks
params.values: Number of timer ticks by which your model can trail the kernel 10 (default) | integer

params.name: Show “Missed Ticks” port
params.values: Send number of missed ticks to port Missed Ticks ’off’ (default) | ’on’

params.name: Yield CPU when waiting
params.values: Yield CPU while kernel waits for hardware ’off’ (default) | ’on’

params.name: Quadrature mode
params.values: To detect optically the amplitude and direction of movement, select encoder stripe edges quadruple (default) | double | single | two-pulse

params.name: Reset input function
params.values: Select mode of reset pin reset (default) | gate | rising edge index | falling edge index

params.name: Input filter clock frequency
params.values: Cutoff frequency (Hz) of low-pass filter Inf (default) | scalar

params.name: Output data type
params.values: Data type of block output double (default) | single | int8 | uint8 | int16 | uint16 | int32 | uint32
